title: Cosine Similarity Matrix
signature: def cosine_similarity(A: np.ndarray, B: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
hints: Cosine similarity is the dot product of the two unit vectors.
Normalize every row of A and every row of B first. Then one matrix product gives all n*m similarities.
A zero row has norm 0. Divide it by 1 instead, so it stays a zero vector and its dot products come out 0.
